title: {session}-traces/review/result-{attempt}.json
description: Output of agents/reviewer.md (step 10.5). Validated by orchestrator post-spawn via validate-json.sh. See skills/apex/review.md.

findings.description: Up to 5 ranked findings (top by user impact: security > pattern > over-engineering > i18n > complexity); optional 6th synthetic 'additional' entry when more than 5 issues were observed.

file.description: Repo-relative path or '(synthetic)' for the 'additional' overflow entry.

line.description: 1-based line in file; 0 when synthetic / file-level.

summary.description: One-line description of the finding. May be prefixed STILL-PRESENT-AFTER-FIX: on attempt 2.

severity.description: Optional. Advisory findings do not force fix-needed; actionable findings do.

action.description: pass = proceed to step 11; fix-needed = dispatch executor cap-1 then re-review; escalate = AskUserQuestion.
